'''Veo Holden''' was a [[human]] [[Jedi Master]] who lived during the [[High Republic Era]].

==Biography==
[[File:Ki-Adi-Mundi 132 BBY.png|thumb|left|340px|Holden with Master Ki-Adi-Mundi.]]
In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Veo Holden participated in a small council meeting called by Master [[Vernestra Rwoh]] to discuss the emergence of the [[Force-sensitive]] [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]]. After the group reviewed [[Holocamera|holocam]] footage provided by Master [[Sol]] of Mae in combat with him, Holden noted that the assassin's fighting abilities were weak because she relied heavily on emotion to guide her actions. Sol and Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] pointed out that Mae had demonstrated some skill, indicating that she had received training. This led Holden to ask who had done so, with Sol stating that Mae did not know her Master's identity, an idea ridiculed by Mundi.<ref name="Episode IV" />

Holden then speculated that Mae and her Master might be evidence of a splinter Order or something worse while Mundi declared that Mae could pose a great threat to them. When Sol argued that she was undisciplined, Rwoh pointed out that Mae had managed to evade him and kill two Masters [[Indara]] and [[Torbin]], with [[Kelnacca]] still alive. Rwoh also corrected Sol when he stated that Mae had targeted the trio, pointing out that he was also on Mae's list, a convenient thread tying all four of them to her: they were all stationed on Mae's [[Brendok|home planet]] when she was a child. Rwoh also mentioned that it was odd that Mae had now appeared years later, having been trained by a Jedi. When Holden questioned her on this, Rwoh stated that what she had seen in the [[hologram]] was confirmation enough.<ref name="Episode IV" />

When Mundi said that they must inform the [[Jedi High Council|High Council]], Rwoh insisted that they keep the matter to themselves, arguing that the Council would be obliged to inform the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]], which could result in a scandal capable of spreading fear and mistrust. Deciding that the group needed more information, Rwoh ordered Holden to go retrieve Kelnacca from [[Khofar]] and intercept Mae there. When Holden asked what to do if Mae resisted, Rwoh stated that she did not expect such an outcome and adjourned the meeting.<ref name="Episode IV" />

However, Rwoh soon changed her mind after Sol convinced her to let him lead the [[Mission to Khofar|mission]] instead of Holden, who witnessed their conversation while accompanying Mundi out of the room. Ultimately Holden remained on [[Coruscant]] while Sol led his own team to Khofar.<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veo Holden was created for the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''. The character was portrayed by [[Indra Ové]].<ref name="Episode IV" />
